links.note: UNLINK. Was 25239 'नूह का लक़ब'. The item asks where the writer now lives (मुंबई). 25239 is about the epithet given to Noah -- no relation at all, and no concept in this set records the writer's city.

RE-LINK from 25245 'समंदर का सिमटना'. The question is how life has shrunk into houses, keyed 'छोटा-छोटा डिब्बा'. That belongs with 25243 'बस्तियों का फैलाव', the spread of settlements and what it does to living space. 25245 is specifically the sea being pushed back.
